limits: Finding-level independent verdicts only, not requirement status or certification. FIXED is scoped to the specified original defect. Static evidence is distinguished from executable evidence in each assessment. Missing candidate code is not a fix. AST indexing covers functions/classes, not numeric registry IDs or constants.

findings.title: Reopened status is overridden by executor gate membership
findings.required_behavior: Explicit reopening must take precedence; distinguish executable residue from a valid external dependency.
findings.assessment: C-74 classify gives explicit PARTIAL/no parked_on precedence over executor membership. All 60 reopened-row controls pass again at 2e66b3a; this repairs the specific C-65 hiding defect, not semantic proof.

findings.title: Module reachability is mistaken for requirement proof
findings.required_behavior: Reachability is necessary evidence, not sufficient proof of the requirement.
findings.assessment: proof_of still accepts module existence, named/imported tests and at least one reached module. It does not bind a requirement to the required output, consumer or action. No actual test execution receipt is required by this Boolean.

findings.title: Unchecked gates can coexist with closed_out
findings.required_behavior: Do not present unchecked gate state as verified closure.
findings.assessment: matrix now requires successful live gate reads before closed_out. Three isolated zero-OPEN controls pass at 2e66b3a: missing DB and read failure stay indeterminate; successful live-read control closes.

findings.title: Unique-value comparison permits unmeasured or unsupported superiority
findings.required_behavior: An advantage must be established on comparable evidence for the actual product; retain the requirement's refusal semantics.
findings.assessment: compare_advantages still calls an advantage beyond when benchmark best is below MATCHED_AT, without comparing a measured score of this release. Latest Platform verification explicitly confirms this limitation.

findings.title: Delight scores are fixed proxies and can use another version
findings.required_behavior: Keep capability proxies distinct from product-specific measured delight and real improvement effects.
findings.assessment: measured_self_scores uses fixed presence-based scores and slug-wide ArtefactProvenance. Latest Platform verification confirms cross-version/proxy issue; this is not measured product delight.

findings.title: Frame review can clear unjudged, empty or stale evidence
findings.required_behavior: Review every required current frame for applicable claims; unknown stays unknown; changed bytes invalidate approval.
findings.assessment: _review_frames promotes described/unjudged to clear; frame_review_state accepts empty frames and keys approvals by slug@version without current bytes. C-80 explicitly records these defects. Source review only; no image API or Visual edit.

findings.title: Polling backoff grows without a new observation
findings.required_behavior: Backoff increments only after a newly completed unchanged attempt and eventually allows a probe.
findings.assessment: _free_poll_backoff resets next-attempt time from now using the same completed observation tail. C-80 confirms repeated sweeps can extend delay without a new observation.

findings.title: New build SHA stands in for changed failure hypothesis
findings.required_behavior: Retry must name changed relevant conditions or hypothesis and retain the cost/retry ceiling.
findings.assessment: retry_allowed permits the same failed call after any build SHA change; it does not require a relevant changed hypothesis. C-80 confirms the issue.

findings.title: Lane enforcement needs atomic concurrent admission
findings.required_behavior: Concurrent workers must neither exceed lane/function capacity nor mutually defer all runnable work.
findings.assessment: Lane/claim implementations are present, but this lane has no faithful concurrent multi-worker/Postgres admission trace. Existing isolated controls are insufficient to resolve the original race-risk specification.

findings.title: Rebuild completion is not strictly request-bound
findings.required_behavior: Completion must match requested artifact identities, dependencies/fingerprints and the actual rebuild attempt.
findings.assessment: Targeted rebuild machinery and G03 slug resolution exist, but completion is not strictly bound to the requested attempt and new fingerprints. Latest Platform verification records this under #172/C-80; not repaired by the scoped-slug fix.

findings.title: Escalation plans do not prove distinct rung execution
findings.required_behavior: Each attempted strategy must change the intended inputs/tool/composition and progress only on evaluated results.
findings.assessment: Escalation rungs still dispatch the same photography job; no distinct input/tool change and durable rung-result progression. C-80 corroborates. No generation was run.

findings.title: Launch readiness uses weak rollback and baseline proxies
findings.required_behavior: Readiness must cite successful relevant restore evidence and an identified prelaunch analytics baseline.
findings.assessment: Launch readiness uses seo_score/any OperatingReading for analytics baseline and retained certificate/continuity proof for rollback. These are not actual prelaunch traffic and withdrawal rehearsal; C-80 confirms the downstream readiness-consumer gap.

findings.title: Experiment cost attribution is partly a job-type proxy
findings.required_behavior: Separate actual experiment IDs from unattributed/category spend; do not claim per-experiment evidence for proxies.
findings.assessment: _experiment_of still falls back to exploration:<job_type>. Latest Platform verification confirms category-attributed spend is not a registered experiment's cost.

findings.title: Continuous critical-dependency actions remain absent
findings.required_behavior: Existing dependency inventory must be refreshed and missing backup/recovery strategies or failed probes must produce proportional action.
findings.assessment: The former absence of a recurring action path is corrected: dependency cadence, incidents and caps exist; focused dependency suite passes. Current Platform verification identifies constant-ok Railway probe and unprobed dependencies. Full critical-dependency recovery coverage remains unqualified.

findings.title: Validated-products-per-dollar optimization remains absent
findings.required_behavior: Track the specified artifacts/minutes/costs and optimize using actual validated output and contribution.
findings.assessment: Unit-cost minutes/ratios and governor consumer now exist; spend-without-validated-output cap test passes. Whole optimization claim is not proved: unit_costs sums contribution across all LedgerEntry dates while operating costs use the window, and broad scans remain C-80 work.

findings.title: Recognizability without model remains unevidenced
findings.required_behavior: Evidence must cover the master's named brand signatures and product-first continuity.
findings.assessment: Passing moat suite verifies evidence inventory and signature-count proxies, not independent product-first recognizability without the model. Current Platform verification retains #44 partial and records that distinction.

findings.title: Opportunity scorers do not consume evidence freshness/population weighting
findings.required_behavior: Preserve source/window/population and discount stale/mismatched evidence before selection or current-demand claims.
findings.assessment: Radar freshness/population tests pass on the integrated scorer and SERP captures carry stamps. Current Platform verifier still reports unstamped MJs observations; Intel differentiation consumer named by original finding is not integrated. Not a blanket fix.

findings.title: Seasonal takeover has plans but no proven apply/revert executor
findings.required_behavior: Due transitions and reversion must pass authorized surface/quality gates and be durably recoverable.
findings.assessment: Actual persisted apply/revert and quality refusal for banner surface now exist; focused takeover tests pass. Latest Platform verifier notes shop_content/featured_collection APPLIED states have no renderer. Former total executor absence is fixed; all-surface effect/recovery claim needs re-audit.

findings.title: Receipt state is not reconciled for late full or partial refunds
findings.required_behavior: Represent current payment/refund truth per transaction and reconcile changes without double counting; discover updates to old receipts.
findings.assessment: Latest-head adversarial tests reproduce late full refund ignored, partial $2 refund treated as full $12, and a 60-day-old modified receipt excluded by creation watermark. C-78 prose says fixed but current source bytes are unchanged from 4edacff.

findings.title: Unpaid and cancelled receipts can become sales
findings.required_behavior: Only eligible paid transactions count as sales; cancelled/unpaid/unknown states have explicit non-sale treatment.
findings.assessment: Latest-head tests import $12 revenue from is_paid=false/status=open and status=canceled fixtures. lines/_record_line still do not filter payment state; C-78 source mismatch applies.

findings.title: Historical sale versions are assigned from current listing state
findings.required_behavior: Bind sale to the delivered version or retain unknown; do not fabricate historical certainty.
findings.assessment: Latest-head test attributes a 60-day-old sale to current version 2.0.0 created two days ago. No sale-time listing history resolution exists in current _catalogue.

findings.title: Out-of-order history corrupts first-purchase and repeat cohorts
findings.required_behavior: First acquisition/product and repeat classification must be invariant to arrival order.
findings.assessment: Latest-head out-of-order test leaves first_seen_at at the newer receipt date. Existing customer early-return preserves arrival order rather than earliest paid history.

findings.title: Crash can leave order without version or ledger evidence
findings.required_behavior: Restart must converge to a complete, exactly-once logical transaction with traceable partial state.
findings.assessment: Latest-head injected post-Order-commit interruption, reopened DB and retry produce Order=1, OrderVersion=0, Ledger=1. Ledger repairs; sale-version evidence does not. Deterministic transaction interruption, not a real worker SIGKILL proof.

findings.title: Unknown Etsy acquisition becomes organic and loop counters resist correction
findings.required_behavior: Unknown attribution stays unknown; loop metrics reconcile refunds/corrections and distinguish event counts from net outcomes.
findings.assessment: Current acquisition producer writes etsy; SOURCE_TO_LOOP maps it to etsy_organic, and loop_block adds max(0, desired-have). Unknown attribution and downward correction defects remain; source identical across 4ed..2e.

findings.title: Negative contribution is suppressed and fee estimates can look measured
findings.required_behavior: Retain losses and mark estimated versus measured money inputs end to end.
findings.assessment: Latest-head one-cent sale has ledger net -0.27 and Order contribution 0.00. Negative economics are clamped; estimated money inputs are not fully propagated as distinct measured/estimated provenance.

findings.title: Pricing and offer guards may annotate rather than prevent actions
findings.required_behavior: Disallowed discounts, impossible net floors and protected retirement must stop their actual downstream action.
findings.assessment: decide_price still returns a price after an impossible net floor warning. Latest handle_pricing_position appends guard prose then enqueues listing.seo; portfolio guard changes intervention prose but retains discard-shaped label. Claimed PriceDecision.refused/stop contract is absent.

findings.title: Certification is treated as correction without correction scope
findings.required_behavior: Distinguish routine versions from correction releases and approved releasability; prepare notices only for affected buyers.
findings.assessment: on_certified remains the old routine-new-certification correction producer. C-78's correction-of-version/hash and eligible-release scope are absent from current source. No actual buyer messaging was performed.

findings.title: North-star metrics use draft and research proxies
findings.required_behavior: Compute each named metric from its actual lifecycle event; unavailable observations remain unmeasured.
findings.assessment: north_star_cohorts remains unchanged: draft Listing presence and research/tournament proxies substitute for named lifecycle outcomes. Reported cir.drafted/store.published rewrite is not in the integrated source.

findings.title: Third steering run repeats priority movement
findings.required_behavior: Repeated execution of the same steering decision must be idempotent across runs and restarts.
findings.assessment: C-75 reads immutable growth.steered receipts as well as prior readings; repeated handler runs no longer erase moved IDs and move them on the third run. Named regression passed; b9f7e3a also exempts these receipts from retention. This verdict is the original third-run defect, not a general concurrency proof.

findings.title: Steering escapes protected priority bands
findings.required_behavior: One priority authority must preserve customer/truth protection and bounded permitted urgency.
findings.assessment: Independent regression at latest head: actual pending chain.rebuild priority 25, fast-lane steer delta -20, stored result 5. It outranks customer 10 and truth 15 after one run. C-75 idempotence does not bound priority composition. Actual JobQueue.claim also selects chain.rebuild while a priority-10 support.reply job remains waiting; see out/growth_followups_2e66b3a_claim.json.

findings.title: Fast-lane targeted rebuild request is not consumed
findings.required_behavior: Contract must explicitly resolve requested slugs to scoped release/artifact targets or reject unsupported input.
findings.assessment: C-76 resolves slugs to scoped product rebuild targets and refuses unknown requested products instead of scanning the catalogue. Named scoped-request regression passed; latest function remains equivalent for this contract. P10 attempt/fingerprint binding is separate.

findings.title: Commercial evidence has consumers but no normal producer
findings.required_behavior: Connect supported evidence sources with provenance or remain unmeasured; never infer missing commercial truth.
findings.assessment: Normal orders producer still does not supply the review-star/offsite/creator attribution fields consumed by Growth readings. Fixtures can populate them; that proves consumers, not a production evidence chain.

findings.title: Blank agreements can pass tester graduation
findings.required_behavior: Verify separate actual agreements and consent before relationship transition; eligibility is not completed graduation.
findings.assessment: creators_reading still passes empty testing_terms and ambassador_terms; may_graduate has no nonempty separate-agreement requirement. Result creates an owner offer card, not a completed ambassador transition; actual graduation must not be inferred.

findings.title: Distribution plans are not executable production chains
findings.required_behavior: Every claimed produced/distributed result needs a real consumer; unavailable external surfaces stay gated.
findings.assessment: Distribution persists plans for pins/clusters/video/tools, without full executable asset/publication consumers for every claimed surface. Keep plan output distinct from produced/distributed work and preserve external gates.

findings.title: Club cadence uses release spacing and lacks feasibility input
findings.required_behavior: Separate throughput observations from production lead time and answer only supported feasibility inputs.
findings.assessment: _club_answers derives cadence from release spacing and lacks actual production-feasibility inputs. A historical interarrival interval does not establish sustainable promised production lead time.

findings.title: Support draft timing can prevent later delivery measurement
findings.required_behavior: Track draft-ready and sent/received timing separately; trust uses actual delivered service.
findings.assessment: Draft handling stores response_minutes with draft_ready; record_response refuses any second timing when that key exists. A later sent observation cannot replace the draft measure through this writer.

findings.title: Unknown traffic and absent contribution distort benchmark readings
findings.required_behavior: Maintain unknown source and compute contribution only from reconciled matching observations; no measured ranking from absent inputs.
findings.assessment: benchmark_observations still defaults missing traffic_source to etsy_search. Correction: it does aggregate contribution when Order rows exist; do not claim contribution is always None. That aggregation inherits unresolved Orders loss/refund correctness.

findings.title: Calibration can score overlapping or missing observations as actuals
findings.required_behavior: Forecast evaluation requires complete comparable actual windows, deduplication and explicit missingness.
findings.assessment: Calibration still lacks fully comparable, deduplicated actual-window completeness; missing/overlapping observations can look like numerical outcomes. Existing audit source contract remains; no new live forecast outcome proof claimed.

findings.title: Planning-time ads gates are not an execution-time guarantee
findings.required_behavior: Before any future protected spend, re-read current authority, trust, eligibility, listing state and budgets atomically enough to prevent stale-plan bypass.
findings.assessment: Campaign execution rechecks owner authority/caps and hard-refuses actual production spend because no ad integration exists. It does not establish future execution-time trust/eligibility freshness. No current paid-effect bypass was demonstrated; future protected executor must revalidate.

findings.title: Experiment rank changes may only reorder the dashboard
findings.required_behavior: Continuous execution must consume the selected constraint/rank without weakening experiment gates.
findings.assessment: steer_rank is written on RegisteredExperiment and consumed by war_room board sorting; no actual experiment execution-priority consumer was found. Display ordering is not execution steering.

findings.title: Ads eligibility countdown and credit/cash separation are absent
findings.required_behavior: Retain the owner's explicit countdown requirement using verified current shop evidence; no invented date or spend.
findings.assessment: No verified shop-eligibility countdown or credit-versus-cash ledger/producer was added. Keep owner authority and unknown date; no ad spend or invented eligibility date.

findings.title: Winner judgement contract lacks a proven production writer
findings.required_behavior: Actual judge jobs must emit hash-bound, named, independent evidence for every mandatory check; absence holds engineering.
findings.assessment: Design now includes judge_held and regate_held producing named concept.judged evidence, so 'no producer' is outdated. Producer stores slug and truncated board path, not image/content hashes; required independent/current-evidence binding remains unproved. No provider call made.

findings.title: Reconsideration misses changed prerequisite evidence
findings.required_behavior: Any relevant new grid/top-decile/capability evidence should trigger bounded idempotent reconsideration.
findings.assessment: regate_held reconsiders only when thumbnail_reads_small or craft_impression differs from known judgement. Newly changed grid/top-decile/capability prerequisites alone need not trigger reconsideration.

findings.title: Gap progression can attach to the wrong arena
findings.required_behavior: Carry exact gap, event, arena and winning design identity through every stage.
findings.assessment: _gap_for selects the first CoverageGap by pod/id; advance_gap accepts pod rather than exact originating gap/event/arena. New Design integration carries the original provenance defect into current code.

findings.title: Pipeline report advances on artifact or listing existence
findings.required_behavior: Each stage must have the required result and consumer for that exact release; missing terminal stages remain incomplete.
findings.assessment: _stage_evidence uses any slug-wide assets and any certified PatternVersion; _challenge_for sends category empty/our_scores empty and treats not blocks_release as passed. This does not bind premium/benchmark proof to the precise current release.

findings.title: Draft age can become launch-failure evidence
findings.required_behavior: No launch failure without verified launch age and sufficient observable opportunity; source absence differs from zero sales.
findings.assessment: response_outcomes now selects a published listing, but uses listing.created_at as publication age and emits no-sale failure after days without proof of exposure or readable sales source. Draft-to-published age and unknown-versus-zero remain unresolved.

findings.title: Seller language is labelled buyer evidence
findings.required_behavior: Distinguish seller wording from measured buyer queries; preserve source and population.
findings.assessment: buyer_language delegates to intent.strategy using observed BenchmarkListing titles and title share. Seller wording is observed; measured buyer query population is not established by those titles.

findings.title: Breakthrough and cardigan end-to-end scope remains unfinished
findings.required_behavior: Implement the specified design/engineering/visual progression or retain exact honest blocker; do not rename a stopped-path test success as product completion.
findings.assessment: Design pipeline/intake/seasonal transformation and tests are integrated, but original-engine garment/cardigan end-to-end scope remains partial in the report. New wiring is not a finished certified original product. Do not rerun Visual or declare completion.

findings.title: Funnel evidence must bind the actual concept payload
findings.required_behavior: Only the carried concept/version/hash may use its funnel evidence.
findings.assessment: verify_funnel reads latest intake by slug and evaluates stored original_key/rounds; it does not bind approval to the actual concept payload/version/hash supplied for engineering.

findings.title: Rollback state commits before rollback effect
findings.required_behavior: After failure/restart, rollback remains pending until the active configuration/floor is restored and verified.
findings.assessment: Audited candidate monitor_trials/rollback/_rollback_self_audit are absent from integrated head; Improve d033e02 remains unmerged. Missing implementation does not resolve rollback durability. Re-run original fault-injection spec after actual merge.

findings.title: Replay model differs from multi-worker runtime
findings.required_behavior: Replay claims must be scoped to faithfully simulated behavior; promotion must preserve protected bands and account for actual worker/lane semantics.
findings.assessment: improve/replay.py is absent from integrated head. The candidate multi-worker/lane-model mismatch has no integrated executable target yet; do not count candidate simulation as runtime proof.

findings.title: New replay record can be mistaken for fresh post-promotion evidence
findings.required_behavior: Freshness must bind task identities/content/windows and independent post-promotion outcomes; reused holdout is not fresh evidence.
findings.assessment: Candidate replay cycle/latest_pair/monitor are unmerged. Freshness must be based on new independent task/content/window evidence, not a newly timestamped replay record; original stale-holdout spec remains pending.

findings.title: Registered test filenames are not test execution provenance
findings.required_behavior: Separate declared validation coverage from actual executed result tied to source/environment.
findings.assessment: Candidate register_code_versions/_policy_payloads are absent. Actual executed-test provenance has not been established on the current integrated source; filenames remain only declared coverage.

findings.title: Lesson matches receive invented currency-valued priority
findings.required_behavior: Heuristic priority must not appear as measured expected business value or realized learning benefit.
findings.assessment: Candidate improve/consume.py::act is unmerged while Design changes radar flow. Do not apply old candidate result to current runtime or treat heuristic lesson uplift as measured money.

findings.title: Adopting an audit floor does not implement the underlying improvement
findings.required_behavior: Trace proposal to a specific implemented change, independent reevaluation and actual consuming artifact/response.
findings.assessment: Candidate self-audit execution and teardown/enforce.py are unmerged. Audit-floor adoption still requires proof of implemented change and independent consuming effect after integration.

findings.title: Self-audits and keyword checks can certify wrong content
findings.required_behavior: Bind audits to release/content hashes and compare applicable benchmark scope; keyword presence alone cannot prove correctness.
findings.assessment: Candidate teardown/enforce.py judgement/keyword checks are absent. Content/hash binding and benchmark applicability remain original negative specifications to execute after merge.

findings.title: Taste and function-quality heuristics overstate independent quality
findings.required_behavior: Label screening heuristics and evidence limits; reward observed quality/outcomes rather than row production.
findings.assessment: Candidate taste_judge/function_quality/activity_from_db functions are not integrated. Proxy quality and activity-count concerns are not cleared by absence; no independent quality proof established.

findings.title: Priority-policy replay is not a general challenger engine
findings.required_behavior: State implemented challenger scope accurately; model/tool evaluation and approved architecture execution need their own real paths.
findings.assessment: Replay/evolution additions are absent. A general model/tool/architecture challenger engine cannot be inferred from existing nightly handler registration or candidate priority-policy simulation.

findings.title: Veto withholding must survive all rebuild paths
findings.required_behavior: One durable release eligibility record must represent all withholding reasons and all downstream paths must consume it.
findings.assessment: Current pipeline persists some withholding and rebuild refusals; Improve standards_gate is absent. Combined owner/standards/teardown hash-bound veto survival still needs full direct/retry/rebuild negative traces after integration.

findings.title: Repeated unchanged policy snapshot erases unreviewed change
findings.required_behavior: Unreviewed material change remains blocking until review/test evidence covers the effective changed version.
findings.assessment: record_snapshot still compares with the immediately previous digest; candidate unreviewed_changes/review_change consumers are absent. A->B->B review bypass in that candidate is not an executed latest-head finding or a fix; re-audit when actual guards land.

findings.title: Distinctiveness is substituted for top-decile strength
findings.required_behavior: Measure required concept/presentation strength comparably on current category evidence; rarity is only one input.
findings.assessment: creative/strength.py concept/benchmark score producers are absent; existing _top_decile gate is not proof of comparable quality evidence. Candidate rarity-to-strength substitution remains pending after Intel integration.

findings.title: Fabric swatch does not prove finished-product visual fidelity
findings.required_behavior: Treat swatch as material evidence only; preserve CIR→faithful finished-product 3D reference→photoreal image→truth/benchmark validation objective.
findings.assessment: Candidate creative/board.py swatch producer is absent. No finished-product fidelity is proved by this head or by a material swatch. Original negative specification remains; Visual V2 stays frozen.

findings.title: Photo intake validates hash syntax and rights label, not evidence
findings.required_behavior: Verify stored image bytes/hash, product/version association and recorded permission/license basis before use; retain held state otherwise.
findings.assessment: publish/physical_upgrade.py, photo intake handler and endpoint are absent. Candidate hash-syntax/rights-label checks cannot count as verified bytes/rights. Execute bytes/license negatives only when implemented.

findings.title: Photo planning stops before review/publication but starts impact clock
findings.required_behavior: Upgrade lifecycle must progress through review, recertification and authorized publication; impact anchored to actual exposed version/time.
findings.assessment: Candidate physical upgrade plan/review/publication/impact chain is absent. No current published exposure date/effect is established; planning time must not start impact evidence.

findings.title: Seller location opens a buyer-market evidence gate
findings.required_behavior: Distinguish seller geography from observed buyer/query population; no Canadian/global demand claim from seller address.
findings.assessment: Intel panel_discovery/market_for and benchmark market_of producers are absent. Existing second-market gate must not be credited with buyer-market proof from candidate seller geography; verify actual integration chain later.

findings.title: Drift incidents resolve when evidence ages out or becomes unreadable
findings.required_behavior: Unknown/expired evidence must not establish recovery; only sufficient comparable stable evidence can resolve drift.
findings.assessment: visual/drift_series.py is unmerged. Original evidence-disappears/incident-resolves candidate defect remains a mandatory negative test, not a verified latest-head fix.

findings.title: Benchmark-refresh trigger and purchased candidate can diverge
findings.required_behavior: Request must answer the actual trigger and accurately state baseline policy; avoid duplicate purchased information.
findings.assessment: intel/benchmark_refresh.py is unmerged. Trigger-to-purchased-candidate correspondence and duplicate-information controls require testing the integrated implementation.

findings.title: Company standing and entry superiority rely on capability/count proxies
findings.required_behavior: Compare current applicable releases; separate potential engineering capability from demonstrated product advantage.
findings.assessment: Candidate company-standing/entry-axis/positioning functions are absent; capability counts are not measured current-product superiority. No latest-head quality result inferred.

findings.title: Quote-token heuristics cover only explicit title forms
findings.required_behavior: Do not infer comprehensive screening from limited token extraction; preserve existing rights gates and declared uncertainty.
findings.assessment: Candidate quote_tokens function is absent; current file_topic alone is not evidence of broad screening. Keep existing rights gates and original limited-extractor concern for later merge.

findings.title: Registry reclassification is not in the preserved patch

Reconcile legitimate parks only after the built halves exist. Numeric registry IDs are not AST symbols; index symbol_found=false is not missing-row proof.

findings.assessment: Current C-73 member-triggered collection behavior and Design edits must be retained; Intel's unmerged patch predates that context. A removed historical test function name is not a functional regression by itself.

findings.title: Duplicate promotion/referral readers can disagree
findings.required_behavior: One documented evidence/window/verdict contract per decision; divergent readers cannot independently authorize actions.
findings.assessment: C-77 fixed referral duplication, but promotion still has two different readers: Order readings consume Cohort/PriceObservation; Growth consumes Experiment arms and may omit spend. Whole original duplicate-reader contract is not fixed.

findings.title: Combined model and registration changes lack integration evidence
findings.required_behavior: Preserve data and register every new normal entry path in both fresh and upgraded databases without touching production.
findings.assessment: Orders/Design models and routes are partially integrated, but candidate PhysicalPhoto and Improve/Intel paths remain absent. Fresh plus upgraded database and registration contract across all clusters has not been run.

findings.title: Final protected actions must combine every applicable gate
findings.required_behavior: Final authorized write/spend must consume current, hash-bound eligibility and budget/owner/policy state, including direct/retry/rebuild paths.
findings.assessment: Current gates include partial withholding and hard ads refusal; Design adds funnel guard, Improve standards_gate absent. No complete proof of all current hash-bound gates at final authorized action/direct/retry paths.

findings.title: Test fixtures can conceal missing production evidence chains
findings.required_behavior: Separate consumer-unit/handler proofs from full producer→consumer certification evidence.
findings.assessment: Growth fixture-seeded reviews/attribution still lack matching normal production producers (G04); Design judgement producer now exists but is not fully hash-bound (D01). Green consumer tests alone do not prove production evidence chains.
